audit_items.proof_trace: Data columns from distributed publishing bypass all 12 gossip validation requirements (proposer signature, KZG proofs, inclusion proofs, parent validity, finality checks) by directly upgrading to VerifiedRODataColumn without verification (L483). Gossip-received columns undergo full spec-compliant validation via GossipDataColumnSidecarRequirements before upgrade. The comment 'We build this block ourselves' assumes trust without cryptographic proof, violating semantic equivalence.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Malicious or compromised validator client produces invalid data column sidecars (e.g., incorrect KZG proofs, wrong inclusion proofs, invalid signatures). These bypass all validation checks via distributed publishing path, get stored in dataColumnStorage, and trigger DataColumnSidecarReceived events, causing downstream systems to process invalid data that would be rejected via gossip.
